Q1: This failure was environmental (actionlint downloads returned HTTP 504 on all 6 tries). What should this issue deliver?
Choices:
A) No code change. Re-run the failed `static-checks` job of CI run 42470227946 on PR #9055 and close this issue once it passes. The pipeline opens no PR. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cache the sha256-verified actionlint binary with `actions/cache` in the `static-checks` job of `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, keyed on `ACTIONLINT_VERSION` + `ACTIONLINT_SHA256`, and add a contract test for it. Leave the existing retry window and checksum check as they are. Most runs would then skip the download.
C) Same as B, but filed as a separate new issue. Close this one as in A.
